links.outcome: Fine-tuned versus zero-shot LLM performance on Romanian cancer-patient medical QA, including cross-center and cross-cancer tests
links.effect: Fine-tuned models significantly outperformed zero-shot models; pretrained models failed to generalize on MedQARo (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Our results show that fine-tuned models significantly outperform zero-shot models, indicating that pretrained models fail to generalize on MedQARo.

unlisted_practices: Language-specific (Romanian) fine-tuning of LLMs for clinical QA

screen.reason: The paper introduces MedQARo, a large-scale Romanian medical QA benchmark based on real cancer patient summaries, evaluating model accuracy and generalization across zero-shot and fine-tuned LLMs without testing organizational deployment practices or guardrails.
